items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I knew him when he was with Luis Russell.

ctx.x: I don't think Johnny -- Charlie, rather, wanted to travel too much. Charlie Holmes didn't want to travel too much either. He had his roots here in New York and he was a very quiet guy. You never saw him. He stayed in a lot, you know. But a wonderful person.
I knew him when he was with Luis Russell. He was the first saxophone player with Lu Russell when I first came to New York.
And we forgot about -- we forgot to mention another great saxophone player out of St. Louis, Tab Smith.
